__comment: TONE MAPPER BLACK PIXELS. Every pixel in this scene is exactly zero (the only object sits behind the camera and is never hit). A correct tone mapper maps black to black, so all three LDR outputs must be black. Filmic and ACES divide each channel by luminance with no guard for L == 0, and casting the resulting NaN to unsigned char is undefined behaviour. On arm64 with -ffast-math this currently happens to come out black, because max/min compile to fmax/fmin which return the non-NaN operand -- so this is a REGRESSION GUARD, not a failing test. It is expected to start failing as soon as the NaN-related compiler flags change, which is exactly when the missing guard starts to matter.
